sections.content: Evaluation combines descriptive language with judgements. Expressions such as es *interesante*, está *bien* hecha, *resulta* *convincente* and no me *parece* original allow you to assess a work. When giving a reason, connect the judgement to a specific feature such as the plot, characters or performance.

items.spanish: La película me parece original y entretenida.
items.english: The film seems original and entertaining to me.

items.spanish: La historia no me parece demasiado interesante.
items.english: The story does not seem very interesting to me.

sections.content: An evaluation should give a judgement and a reason, rather than only saying that something is good or bad.
